name: Agent Market Arena (AMA)
description: AMA is the first lifelong, real-time benchmark for evaluating LLM-based trading agents across multiple financial markets, integrating verified trading data, expert-checked news, and diverse agent architectures for continuous and fair comparison under real market conditions.
reputation: A very new benchmark with little established community adoption so far, aimed at evaluating trading agents in live market settings.
notes: Evaluates multiple LLM-based agents and model backbones in live cryptocurrency and stock markets; enables continuous and reproducible evaluation of financial reasoning and trading intelligence.
